# Dependency transparency

Source: https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/core/integration-quality-scale/rules/dependency-transparency
Retrieved: 2026-08-15

* The source code of the dependency must be available under an OSI-approved
  license.
* The dependency must be available on PyPI.
* The package published to PyPI should be built in and published from a
  public CI pipeline.
* The version of the dependency published on PyPI should correspond to a
  tagged release in an open online repository.

There are no exceptions to this rule.
